summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of BridgeBot UI refresh. All 4 tasks verified: (1) New BridgeBotLogo SVG (overlapping blue/cyan chat bubbles with robot eyes) correctly replaces all lucide-react Bot icons across the entire app. (2) Login page cleanup - centered single-column layout, no robot-hero.png, no 50/50 split. (3) IntersectionObserver-based scroll fade-in animations working on all homepage sections below the hero. (4) Live embedded chat widget iframe in hero section loading correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI refresh fully tested. BridgeBotLogo SVG (viewBox='0 0 48 40') verified on: Landing page navbar, Login page, Register page, Admin dashboard sidebar, Chat page header and avatars, Widget page header and avatars, Docs page header. Login page now uses centered single-column layout without robot-hero.png. Homepage has live demo iframe (src='/widget?mode=inline') that loads the widget correctly. All 10 homepage sections present with fade-in animations: Hero, Channels (5 cards), Knowledge, Live API, Zendesk (mode toggle working), Widget (6 color picker buttons), Dashboard (stat cards + chart), How It Works (3 steps), FAQ (7 accordion items), CTA, Footer. All CTAs link correctly: nav Sign In -> /login, nav Get Started -> /register, hero Start Building Free -> /register, hero Try Live Demo -> /chat. Footer links: Documentation -> /docs, Changelog -> /admin/changelog, Live Demo -> /chat, Sign In -> /login, Create Account -> /register.
